entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who manipulates Jeska, steals black mana with a copy of the Myojin's mask, and duels Nicol Bolas, losing and being killed.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A being on the run from Nicol Bolas who offers Leshrac a copy of her mask; Bolas had earlier defeated her.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker released in Time Spiral who is settling old debts and who defeats Leshrac.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A planeswalker who seals time rifts at others' expense and finally sacrifices herself to seal the Otarian rift.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A member of Teferi's group who buries Multani's mask and seeks out Jodah.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A latent planeswalker who becomes one in his own right and makes his first planeswalk.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A character who no longer has his spark and tries to stop Jeska; he returns to Jamuraa to help rebuild.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: An elf with a latent planeswalker spark from Keld, whom Jeska defeats and uses as a buffer to seal rifts.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The avatar of Yavimaya's forest, incapacitated by the rift and later left inert.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An archmage whom Jhoira seeks out.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: A place with a time rift where Leshrac and Bolas duel.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest whose rift Jeska seals.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A civilization lost when Jeska sealed its rift.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The place of the last time rift, caused by Jeska's transformation into Karona.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Radha's home.

entities.name: Talon Gates
entities.description: A site on Madara that Leshrac defaces to provoke Bolas.

entities.name: Time rifts
entities.description: Rifts over Dominaria that Jeska seals.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The process that alters the nature of the planeswalker spark after all rifts are sealed.

entities.name: Mask of the Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A mask that lets the user drain black mana from others.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane suffering the temporal crisis.

events.summary: On the beaches of Madara the Myojin of Night's Reach offers Leshrac a copy of her mask, and Leshrac accepts the bargain to fight Bolas.
Jeska questions Jhoira, Venser and Teferi, then goes to Otaria where Leshrac proposes using Venser's and Radha's sparks to close the rifts.
events.quote: Leshrac proposes that Jeska use Venser's and Radha ’s latent planeswalker sparks to channel mana and close them

events.summary: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel at Keld and takes her unconscious.
events.quote: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel and takes the unconscious elf with her.

events.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser find Multani incapacitated by the Yavimaya rift.
events.quote: Venser can planeswalk into the rift and free Multani

events.summary: Jeska uses Radha as a buffer to seal the Zhalfirin rift, leaving Radha near death and Zhalfir lost.
events.quote: Jeska is past the point of no return and completes the sealing, leaving Radha close to death.

events.summary: Jeska seals the Yavimayan rift through Radha and Multani's mask, leaving the mask inert; Jhoira buries it.
events.quote: Jhoira buries Multani's mask in the hopes that he can someday be revived

events.summary: Leshrac reveals he had been influencing Jeska, paralyzes her and drains her black mana with the mask.
events.quote: Leshrac paralyzes her and uses the mask of the Myojin of Night’s Reach to drain Jeska’s black mana and corrosive touch from her time as Phage .

events.summary: Leshrac duels Bolas, drains his black mana, defaces the Talon Gates and decays Bolas's body with Phage's corrosive touch.
events.quote: Neither planeswalker can noticeably harm the other until Leshrac defaces the Talon Gates

events.summary: Bolas reveals he had been playing Leshrac, skewers him with his tail and traps his essence with the original mask.
events.quote: Skewering Leshrac with his tail, the dragon uses the mask to drain and trap Leshrac’s essence, winning the duel.

events.summary: Bolas restores Jeska, uses Leshrac's trapped essence to close the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac, and departs Dominaria.
events.quote: Bolas then uses Leshrac’s trapped essence to feed and close it, killing the defeated planeswalker.

events.summary: Jeska sacrifices herself to seal the last rift over Otaria, and the Mending alters the planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Upon its sealing, the nature of the planeswalker spark is inherently altered in the process known as the Mending .

events.summary: The group disbands; Radha returns to Keld, Teferi to Jamuraa, Jhoira seeks Jodah, and Venser makes his first planeswalk.
events.quote: Venser, now a planeswalker in his own right, makes his first planeswalk into the unknown.

relations.note: Used Leshrac's trapped essence to close the rift, killing him.
Settling old debts; he had defeated her earlier.
relations.quote: Bolas states that he had defeated the Myojin of Night’s Reach earlier
Revealing himself to have been subtly influencing Jeska since before he first spoke to her

relations.note: Defeated and used her as a buffer.
relations.quote: Jeska uses Radha as a buffer to fight its consuming pull.
Teferi, Jhoira, and Venser decide to travel to Yavimaya

relations.note: The last time rift over Otaria was caused by her transformation into Karona.
relations.quote: which was caused by her transformation into Karona during the Onslaught storyline
